packet.title: EXI in the sxml command
packet.summary: The commands sxml encode and sxml decode, and --input-format on the commands that read documents.

item.p: Owns: new apps/sxml/command_encode.c, command_decode.c, their golden tests in tests/cli/, their sections in apps/sxml/README.md.
Done when: the golden tests pass; encode refuses to write to a terminal; README and help agree.
